🔍 #Partitioning vs #Bucketing vs #Clustering – Explained Clearly
Understanding the difference between Partitioning, Bucketing, and Clustering is very important for optimizing performance in Big Data systems like Spark, Hive, and BigQuery.
✅ Partitioning
Data is divided based on column values (e.g., date, region).
Reduces data scan
Saves cost
Improves query performance
👉 Best for filtering large datasets
✅ Bucketing
Data is split into a fixed number of files using a hash function.
Faster joins
Less shuffle
Efficient large-table joins
👉 Useful in Spark & Hive environments
✅ Clustering
Data is sorted within partitions based on selected columns.
Faster filtering
Reduced block scanning
Optimized storage
👉 Powerful in BigQuery for query optimization
💡 Key Takeaway:
Use Partitioning for filtering.
Use Bucketing for better joins.
Use Clustering for faster scans inside partitions.
